text: I usually go to my regular clinic, but it was fully booked on the day I went, so I tried this place. I wasn't impressed from the moment I walked in. The counter staff didn't smile or greet me; they just stood there staring intently, waiting for customers to come and tell them they had an appointment. I waited until my number was called, and I was the first one in. When I saw the dentist, I immediately asked, "Is the dentist gentle?" because I was afraid of the pain. The dentist didn't interact at all, just told me to lie down on the chair without any smile to reassure me. The work looked nice and neat afterwards, but after the filling, I couldn't chew at all; my tooth was more sensitive than before. I could only chew soft things. My eldest son went for a teeth cleaning and came back complaining that it hurt so much, every time the dentist put the instrument in his mouth, there was blood everywhere, and his mouth turned red when he rinsed. I'm never coming back here again! I think dental work can be scary for some people. Paying attention to the customer's feelings is important; relieving anxiety and stress is crucial.

text:
This is the worst dental clinic service I've ever experienced.

- The administrator is unprofessional.
Because I previously had a good experience with a dentist (at the Santitham branch), I wanted to keep the same dentist and asked the administrator to check for me, but they told me to call the clinic myself.

- I had an urgent problem with my dentures; they were damaged and needed immediate repair. It turned out I had to get new ones and wait a week. After waiting a week, there was a problem – the dentures didn't fit. I had to order new ones and wait another week. It was a huge waste of time and very frustrating.

- On my second visit to get my dentures fitted, I had an appointment with the dentist, but close to the time, the dentist said they had an urgent flight and had to reschedule. What's the point of having an appointment if this is the case? I informed the clinic beforehand that I needed to take time off work, and I did. How can they reschedule like this? When I arrived at the clinic, the dentist was rushing to leave. During the denture fitting, which required grinding, the assistant covered my face with a cloth, but the dentist pulled it off and ground my tooth, splashing water all over my face. There was no apology whatsoever. It's very disappointing and infuriating.
